caption: Over-representation analysis (GO biological process). Selection: the 15 gene sets with the smallest adjusted P among the 20 with adjusted P < 0.05 (ties broken by larger gene ratio, then term ID); ordered by gene ratio, largest at the top (ties by adjusted P, then term ID). Gene ratio = input genes in the set / input genes annotated in the database. Dot colour, -log10 adjusted P; dot size, number of input genes in the set.

definition.gene_ratio: gene ratio = input genes in the set / input genes annotated in the database
definition.ordering: ordered by gene ratio, largest at the top (ties by adjusted P, then term ID)
